title: Tensoring with a principal localization
statement: Let $R\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and let $f\in R$. Write $R_f$ for the localization at the powers of $f$ and $A_f$ for the localization at the powers of the image of $f$. The canonical $A$-algebra homomorphism $A\otimes_R R_f\to A_f$, sending $a\otimes(r/f^n)$ to $ar/f^n$, is an isomorphism. For every $R$-module $M$, the analogous canonical $R_f$-linear map $R_f\otimes_R M\to M_f$, sending $(r/f^n)\otimes m$ to $rm/f^n$, is also an isomorphism.
